en: A black-and-white photograph of an ornate building featuring prominent classical architectural elements, such as arched windows and sculpted decorations. Two symmetrical towers crowned with statues of figures holding laurel wreaths dominate the façade. Above the entrance arch, the words 'TEATRUL NATIONAL' are inscribed. There are people walking on a curved pathway and stairs leading to the entrance, with well-maintained landscaping in front.
